entities.summary: Gingerbread is an architectural style that consists of elaborately detailed embellishment known as "gingerbread trim". It is more specifically used to describe the detailed decorative work of American designers in the late 1860s and 1870s, which was associated mostly with the Carpenter Gothic style. It was loosely based on the Picturesque period of English architecture in the 1830s.
